payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_credentials.py::test_the_cells_own_token_is_redacted_under_packages_length_guard stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'The guard written as at least eight characters, so the eight-character token is redacted.' applied to saffron/credentials.py as an edit. The claim was "The cell's own token is redacted when `EventLog` is handed it, under PACKAGE's length guard. The witness hands a token of no listed shape and places it in a nested `event` value, a raw `line` and `detail`. Each is written without it and read back with `redacted` naming the cell's own `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. It then hands `None`, an empty token and an eight-character token found in the text. Each event reads back equal to the one appended, and PACKAGE's prose scan finds nothing in that text either.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
